title: Just Juice Apple & Pear on Ice Nic Salt
description: Like taking a long, cooling chug on your favourite summer cider, Just Juice’s Apple & Pear on Ice is a fresh and e-liquid fruity flavour, with a layer of cool, icy menthol on the exhale followed by the mellow sweetness of pear and the crispest green apple taste on the exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. Perfect for smokers or vapers seeking the immediate nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
